senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be stirred up, v. עָרַר,] to wake (act. a. neut.). [Y. B. Bath. III, 14ᵃ וצריך לעורו, read לעורר, v. infra.]—Part. עֵר; f. עֵרָה; pl. עֵרִים; עֵרוֹת, עֵי׳.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:5">B. Kam. II, 5</cite> <he>בין ער בין ישן</he> whether awake or asleep.
<cite ref="Niddah 12a:44">Nidd. 12ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 55b">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:3">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Malachi 2:12">Mal. II, 12</cite>) <he>שלא יהיה לו ער … ועונה וכ׳</he> he shall have none awakening (teaching) among the teachers and none responding among the scholars.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2:1">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>אני ישנה מן המצות ולבי ער לגמילת חסדים</he> I am asleep (negligent) in ceremonies, but my heart is awake for charity; <he>אני ישנה מן הצדקות ולבי ער לעשותן</he> I am asleep (careless) about righteous deeds, but my heart awakens me (stirs me up) to do them; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2:1">ib.</cite> <he>ולבו של הקב״ה ער לגאלני</he> but the heart of the Lord, is awake (anxious) to redeem me; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 46ᵇ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ולבי ער להקב״ה לגאלני</he> but my heart is awake (waiting) for the Lord to redeem me; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:36">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite>; Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Tol’doth 18.

<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Zuta 5:5">Der. Er. Zuta ch. V</cite> <he>לא יהא אדם ער … בין העי׳</he> one must not be awake among those sleeping, nor asleep among those awake. Nidd. l. c. <he>בין ישנות בין ע׳</he> whether they are asleep or awake; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be awake, wake up; to be stirred up, become active.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:3">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>והוה ר״א ישן ור״י נעור</he> (not <cite ref="N01007"><he>ניער</he></cite>) R. E. was asleep, and R. J. awake.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:2">Gitt. VIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Gittin 78a">78ᵃ</cite>) (<cite ref="N01057"><he>נֵי׳</he></cite>) <he>נֵעוֹרָה קוראה וכ׳</he> when she woke up, she read and found it was her letter of divorce.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:4">Ab. III, 4</cite> <he>הנ׳ בלילה</he> he who is awake by night.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 314:1">Sifré Deut. 314</cite> <he>כדי שיעֵוֹרוּ בניו</he> (not <he>שיעירו</he>) that his young brood may wake up; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 944">Yalk. ib. 944</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> (read:] <he>בתחלה הוא נעור וכ׳</he> (or <cite ref="N01007"><he>נִנְעַר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="N01007"><he>נָעַר</he> II</cite>) first he bestirs himself (and proceeds) from the Temple &c.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 73a">Ab. Zar. 73ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מצא מין את מינו וניעור</he> kind found its kind and was stirred up, i.e. the two equal elements in the mixture join to become working agents.—V. <cite ref="N01007"><he>נָעַר</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to wake up; to stir up, instigate.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 43:3">Gen. R. s. 43</cite> <he>מי הוא זה שה׳ לבם של מזרחיים וכ׳</he> who was he that stirred up the heart of the eastsrn nations that they should come and fall &c.?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 311">Yalk. Is. 311</cite> <he>שה׳ בלבם של אזרחיים</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 311">Ib.</cite> <he>ישנים … ומי הֵעִירָן לבא וכ׳</he> the nations were too indifferent to come under the wings of the Lord, and who waked them up to come under his wings? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:6">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>מפריחי יונים</he>, <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">ib. III, 3</cite>) <he>אלו שמְעִירִין וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שממרין</he>) those who stir up the pigeons (on which they bet), v. <cite ref="M02562"><he>מָרָה</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>שה׳ מן העולם</he>, v. <cite ref="P01236"><he>עֵר</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:17">Yalk. ib. 145</cite>.

senses.gloss: to wake up. Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ (ref. to Ps. LVII, 9) דרכן … להיות השחר מְעוֹרְרָן it is usual with kings that the dawn wakes them up; Tanḥ. B’ha‘ăl. 10 דרך השחר מְעוֹרֵר … מעורר וכ׳ usually the dawn wakes the sons of man, but I wake the dawn up. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ bot. היודע … הוא יְעוֹרֵר אתכם he that knows your numbers wake you (from death); a. fr.—Y. Ter. V, end, 43ᵈ מעורר את מינו ליאסר stirs up its kind (makes it an agent) to become forbidden, v. supra.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:15">Maas. Sh. V, 15</cite> <he>בטל את המְעוֹרְרִים</he> abolished the wakers; <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:10">Sot. IX, 10</cite>, expl.

<cite ref="Sotah 48a:7">ib. 48ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 13:9">Tosef. ib. XIII, 9</cite> <he>מעוררין אילו הלוים וכ׳</he> the wakers are the Levites, who … sang, Awake &c. (<cite ref="Psalms 44:24">Ps. XLIV, 24</cite>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7">Lev. R. s. 7</cite>, beg. <he>שנאה … היא עוֹרְרָה עליהן דיני דינין</he> hatred … stirred up against them judgment upon judgment; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to excite to lamentation, arrange a memorial service, engage a travelling wailer.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:5">M. Kat. I, 5</cite> <he>לא יְעוֹרֵר וכ׳</he> one must not arrange a memorial service &c., v. <cite ref="O01320"><he>סַפְדָּנָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 8a:17">ib. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לא יערער</he>, v. <cite ref="P01417"><he>עִרְעֵר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to raise an objection; to contest the legality of. Y. B. Bath. III, 14ᵃ (interch. with עָרַר) מכיון שערר … צריך לעוֹרֵר עליו since he contested the right of possession in three successive years, he need no longer contest.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>צריך לעורו</he> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="P01454"><he>עָרַר</he></cite> a. <cite ref="P01417"><he>עִרְעֵר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be waked up; to bestir one’s self. Lev. R. l. c. עד שנה שנִתְעוֹרְרָה עליהן וכ׳ up to the year when it (hatred) was stirred up against them &c.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:6">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:16">Cant. IV, 16</cite>) <he>לכשיִתְעוֹרְרוּ הגליות וכ׳</he> when the exiled colonies in the north are waked up (to be redeemed), they will come &c.; <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:16">ib.</cite> <he>לכשיִתְעוֹרֵר גוג וכ׳</he> when Gog bestirs himself (to war) &c.
<cite ref="Song of Songs 4:16">Ib.</cite> <he>דבר שהוא ישן ונתע׳</he> a thing (the daily offering) which was asleep (during the captivity) and has been reawakened (reinstated); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be lively; to enjoy one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 149:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLIX</cite> <he>הִתְעוֹרְרוּ עלי וכ׳</he> enjoy yourselves with me at your pleasure.
